data.description: Chat messages live only in apps/chat/data/chat.db (gitignored, WAL mode, single machine, no backup). Decision (Forrest + investor chat, 2026-08-30): make chat history durable by committing append-only JSONL exports to the repo. Design already decided: (1) add a 'chat export' subcommand to apps/chat/bin/chat.js that dumps per-conversation append-only JSONL to a tracked directory (e.g. apps/chat/data/export/ — un-ignore that path), deterministic ordering so re-runs diff cleanly; (2) wire an export+commit step into the /advance tick procedure (.claude/commands/advance.md) at the point where master is pushed after a merged task — NOT a git pre-push hook (hooks that mutate create commits that miss the in-flight push) and NOT PR-open (our flow has no PRs, local --no-ff merges only); (3) add the export path to .gitattributes merge=union alongside Lattice events; (4) add a carve-out to CLAUDE.md Git Methodology for operational record commits (suggested format: 'records: chat export <date>') since these recurring commits belong to no single task. Acceptance: chat export is idempotent, export files round-trip the messages table faithfully (authors, threads, timestamps), /advance documents the step, methodology updated.
data.title: Chat history durability: JSONL export committed to git

data.body: Planning done (plan: plans/task_01M188FN1EADWKP6WRM0KN7ERD.md). Key decisions: (1) export is a NEW artifact, not 'chat dump' — dump includes read_state/ingested_events which mutate in place and would wreck append-only diffs; export covers only the insert-only tables (identities, conversations+members, messages). (2) One JSONL file per conversation with a self-describing header line; DM filenames use an injective ':'->'~', '|'->'~~' mapping (identity alphabet excludes both chars, so no collisions). (3) Idempotency = determinism: fixed key order, ORDER BY id, no export-run timestamps in content; re-run with no new messages is byte-identical, so the /advance commit step no-ops naturally. (4) .gitignore must change from 'apps/chat/data/' to 'apps/chat/data/*' + negation — the current directory-form rule makes any un-ignore inside it dead. (5) Verified no compose changes needed: cli service already bind-mounts ./data and runs as user node. Deliberately left out: restore/import tooling (speculative), atomic-rename writes (no concurrent writer in a sequential tick), read_state export. Flag for the record: DM exports put private conversations in git — fine while the repo is the company's own record, revisit if it goes public or once AS-6 #board exists.
Board directive (DM 53, Forrest): ship it. Implementation starts this tick cycle — Marcus takes it from the plan. Hiring latitude granted if the queue needs more hands.

Implementation done on feat/AS-5-chat-export, 3 commits: c5563c1 (store.exportFiles() + chat export subcommand + 5 new node:test cases + README), a0ead3c (.gitignore data/* + !data/export/ carve-out, .gitattributes merge=union for export/*.jsonl), 40b51f5 (baseline export: 7 conversations, 54 messages, 7 identities). Suite: 27 pass / 0 fail in-container, zero mounts. Verified on the real DB: two back-to-back exports leave git status clean; chat.db stays ignored (git check-ignore); union attr active (git check-attr). Per orchestrator instruction, my CLAUDE.md 'Operational record commits' subsection and the advance.md tick-step wording are edited in the working tree but deliberately NOT committed — those two files carry the board member's uncommitted metawork and he commits them himself. Also left uncommitted: a pre-existing one-word metawork hunk in apps/chat/README.md (investor->board) that predates me — I staged my README hunks selectively around it. QA: scrutinize the append-only contract (test 3), the dm filename ~ mapping injectivity claim, and that the exported key order matches the plan's line-1/line-N spec exactly.
